data.title: Millrose Properties to Provide Capital Support for Dream Finders Homes' Announced Acquisition of Beazer Homes with Up to $1.25 Billion Commitment
data.description: In Miami, Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP, "Millrose"), a platform for residential homebuilders, revealed that its manager will offer acquisition financing of up to $1.25 billion to back Dream Finders Homes, Inc.’s ("Dream Finders") acquisition of Beazer Homes USA, Inc. This commitment marks the third time since Millrose's establishment that it has provided land banking capital to support such endeavors.

data.title: AD HOC GROUP REPRESENTING MAJORITY OF SHERRITT NOTEHOLDERS DISCLOSES RECAPITALISATION ALTERNATIVE AND CALLS ON BOARD TO ENGAGE
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in Toronto, an informal group of investors owning the majority of Sherritt International Corporation's 9.25% 2031 Notes revealed details of a proposed recapitalization plan. This group, known as the Ad Hoc Group, shared important terms of the transaction aimed at restructuring Sherritt's debt obligations. The plan suggests significant changes to the company's financial structure and aims to address concerns related to the outstanding principal amount of the notes.

data.title: MINISO Debuts First Kraków Pop-up Store, Bringing Its Immersive IP Experience to Another Polish City
data.description: MINISO, a popular retailer, launched its inaugural pop-up store at Galeria Krakowska in Kraków, Poland, on August 1, 2026. This move signifies MINISO's introduction to southern Poland and its growing presence in Europe. Galeria Krakowska, located in the center of Kraków, served as the ideal venue for the pop-up. This expansion highlights MINISO's strategic approach to capturing new markets and increasing its footprint globally.

data.title: Construction Partners, Inc. Announces Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results
data.description: In the third quarter of fiscal year 2025, Construction Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROAD) reported a significant increase in its financial performance. The company's revenue saw a 28% rise compared to the same quarter in the previous fiscal year, reaching a notable figure. The adjusted net income also witnessed a substantial growth of 34% in comparison to Q3 FY25. Additionally, the adjusted EBITDA went up by 24% during the same period. The company's backlog set a new record at $3.36 billion. Reflecting on these positive results, Construction Partners, Inc. has raised its outlook for fiscal year 2026. The announcement was made on August 7, 2026, in Dothan, Alabama.

data.title: Thryve.Earth Announces First Corporate Offtake Commitments to Restore 6,000 Hectares in Sulawesi, Indonesia
data.description: In a significant development, the Symbiosis Coalition, comprising Google, McKinsey, and Tencent, has secured a combined contract for the removal of 635,000 tonnes of carbon. This agreement marks Thryve.Earth's initial corporate offtake commitments with the Symbiosis Coalition, a group focused on nature-based carbon solutions. The deal represents a crucial step towards environmental sustainability and signifies a collaborative effort by major industry players to combat climate change.

data.title: Sylvamo Releases Second Quarter Earnings
data.description: Sylvamo (NYSE: SLVM), a global paper company based in Memphis, Tennessee, has announced its second quarter earnings. The company will be hosting an audio webcast at 10 a.m. EDT on investors.sylvamo.com. During this webcast, CEO John Sims will provide a management summary. Some key highlights from the second quarter include successfully implementing price hikes for uncoated freesheet products with customers worldwide. Additionally, Sylvamo is focusing on enhancing its lean transformation initiative to incorporate continuous improvement practices in its operations.
